summary.finding: No M1 cell has a current-trunk evidence chain that proves implementation, an accelerated-backend family oracle, a commit-bound green receipt, and its operating envelope. GLM-5.2-DSA x cuda has the strongest historical candidate, but its public green receipt is not bound to the audited commit; the other cells remain fenced or lack a backend-specific family correctness witness.

non_prenorm_fence.operating_envelope: HAL decode/prefill and Metal prefill reject non-PreNorm topologies before the accelerated forward; CPU family oracles do not execute these backend copies.

mla_backend_exception.operating_envelope: DeepSeek/GLM MLA sessions permit compute.Backend but still reject Metal. Permission proves reachability, not accelerated-backend numerical correctness.

minimax_fence.operating_envelope: Only the CPU f32 resident path is wired; Quant, Q4, Q4K, Backend, Metal, and PrecisionPolicy fail closed.

glm_cuda_historical_candidate.operating_envelope: Synthetic Q8 GLM-MoE-DSA on CUDA sm_80; cosine 1.0 and argmax exact versus CPU Q8 in the 2026-06-30 receipt. The receipt says the runner cloned origin/main but does not record the tested commit, so it cannot witness the audited 2026-08-26 trunk revision.
